frases: Your pergola is going to wobble like jelly!
Hit like and follow. Flo built this one herself!
Four big posts, beams on top. It's rock solid!
Push it sideways, and the square turns into a diamond.
That's called racking. Every gust of wind makes it a little worse.
So I just need bigger posts?
A forty five degree knee brace, where every post meets the beam.
On both sides. Brace one direction, and it still wobbles the other way.
And the bottom of the posts?
Anchor them solid. Deep in the ground, or bolted down tight.
Fine. Triangles. My pergola is a math class now.
Bigger posts, or knee braces? Team Norm or Team Flo?
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
